name: movement-architect
description: Design a movement-led brand and the product ladder that funds it: the leader, the future-based cause and the new opportunity (Expert Secrets), market sophistication and awareness staging (Schwartz), positioning against real alternatives (Dunford), offer construction (value equation), a value ladder from lead magnet to continuity, and packaging into digitally distributable products (skills, playbooks, templates, boilerplates, ebooks, courses, memberships) for marketplaces. Use whenever someone wants to build a movement, manifesto, launch, funnel, lead magnet, offer, pricing ladder or product line, asks what digital product to build or how to position against competitors, or says things like 'make this a bigger idea', 'how do we sell this', 'what should the free thing be', 'write the manifesto', or 'turn this brand into a movement', even when they never say the word funnel.
